'''Cooling compressors''' were a type of cooling technology used on weapons such as the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannons]]. They were used to prevent the weapon from overheating during use. The AG-2Gs on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] were fitted with enhanced cooling compressors and [[cooling pack]]s for prolonged use during combat.<ref name="EGWT" />
